827:  * Format raw seconds into standard 10-foot TV HH:MM:SS string.
828:  * @param {number} totalSeconds

830:  */
831: function formatTime(totalSeconds) {
832:   if (isNaN(totalSeconds) || totalSeconds < 0 || !isFinite(totalSeconds)) {
833:     return '00:00:00';
834:   }
835:   var sec = Math.floor(totalSeconds);
836:   var hours = Math.floor(sec / 3600);
837:   var minutes = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60);
838:   var seconds = sec % 60;
839: 
840:   var hStr = hours < 10 ? '0' + hours : String(hours);
841:   var mStr = minutes < 10 ? '0' + minutes : String(minutes);
842:   var sStr = seconds < 10 ? '0' + seconds : String(seconds);

850: 1. **Progress Fill %**: `(currentTime / duration) * 100`.
